title: The Crystal Potions & More
description: Add New Potions, New Tools, And Even Some Cool Daggers
body:
**What's In The Mod**

Diamond And Netherite Multitools

Gold, Iron, Diamond And Netherite Daggers

The Reality Crystal

The Reality Tools (Sword, Axe, Pickaxe, Shovel, Hoe And Shield)

New Potions (Saturation, Haste, Wither, Luck, Unluck, Strengh, Resistance And The "God Potion")

New Arrow Effects (Saturation, Haste, Wither, Luck, Unluck, Strengh, Resistance And The "God Arrow")

New Soup Effects

New Furnace Fuels

New Biomes

Compatible With JEI

Made For Forge 1.20.1

And More :)

**How To Install?**

Install The Forge Version You Want (The Compatible Ones Are: 47.0.0 - 47.3.33, But I Would Recomend The 47.3.0 Version)

Then Install The Mod Version You Want, It Should Have Installed A ".jar" Archive

You'll Have To Move The ".jar" Archive Into The "Mods" Folder, And That's It
